title: Single Comment Generator with device-based locking, dynamic available count, and admin metrics charts

requirements.summary: Redesign UserView Single Comment Generator section to match the uploaded screenshot with dynamic available count, device-based lock notice, and gradient UI
acceptanceCriteria: Available Comments counter shows a real number from the backend, not 28 or any other hardcoded value
Available Comments counter updates when a different list is selected
Lock notice appears if localStorage contains a claim for the selected list's deviceId+listId combination
Generate button is disabled when the lock notice is visible
Successful generation displays the comment text and a Copy to Clipboard button
Out-of-comments error shows a distinct badge/message instead of the Generate button
Card layout, icon, gradient button, and color scheme match the uploaded screenshot

file_operations.description: Redesign the Single Comment Generator section to match the uploaded screenshot at frontend/public/assets/Screenshot_2026-02-28-08-04-07-838_com.miui.gallery.png. Replace the existing comment generator UI with: (1) a card featuring a blue gradient sparkle/star icon and title/subtitle; (2) retain the existing App/Event selector above the list dropdown; (3) add a 'Select Comment List' dropdown showing only unlocked lists filtered by the selected app/event; (4) add an 'Available Comments' display box that fetches the dynamic count from the backend's getAvailableCount query for the selected list (no hardcoded numbers); (5) add a blue-tinted lock notice box with sparkle icon that appears when localStorage contains a claim for the current deviceId+listId combination; (6) add a 'Generate Single Comment' button with a blue-to-teal gradient matching the screenshot, disabled when the lock notice is visible; (7) on successful generation, display the generated comment text with a Copy button below the card; (8) on 'No comments left' error, show an 'Out of comments' badge instead of the button. Ensure the Available Comments counter updates reactively when the user selects a different list.

requirements.summary: Implement persistent deviceId generation and localStorage-based claim tracking in the frontend
acceptanceCriteria: localStorage 'deviceId' is created on first load and reused on subsequent loads
deviceId is sent with every generateComment call
After a successful generation, the lock notice appears immediately without a page reload
Claim state in localStorage persists across browser tab refreshes

file_operations.description: Create a custom hook that reads the deviceId from localStorage (key 'deviceId') on mount. If missing, generate a new UUID via crypto.randomUUID() and store it in localStorage. Return the deviceId string. This hook ensures a persistent device identifier across sessions.

Add a new mutation hook useGenerateComment that calls the backend's generateComment capability with (listId, deviceId). On success, store the claim in localStorage keyed by listId (e.g., localStorage.setItem(`claim_${listId}`, JSON.stringify({ deviceId, timestamp: Date.now() }))) so the UI can immediately show the lock notice without an extra backend round-trip. Return the generated comment text or error message. Invalidate any relevant queries (e.g., list metrics or available count) after a successful generation.

Import and use the useDeviceId hook to obtain the persistent deviceId. Pass this deviceId to the useGenerateComment mutation when the user clicks 'Generate Single Comment'. After a successful generation, read the claim from localStorage to immediately show the lock notice without requiring a page reload. Ensure the lock notice check runs on component mount and whenever the selected list changes.

requirements.summary: Add Admin Metrics section with dynamic counts, progress bars, and pure SVG/CSS donut charts for each comment list
acceptanceCriteria: Each list has its own metrics card
Total, Used, and Available counts match backend values
Progress bar fill percentage equals usedTemplates / totalTemplates * 100
SVG donut arc correctly represents used vs available proportion
Shows 0% fill when no templates have been used
Shows 100% fill when all templates are used
No Recharts or external chart dependency is added
No hardcoded numbers anywhere in the metrics UI

file_operations.description: Create a reusable React component that renders a pure SVG/CSS donut chart. Accept props: usedTemplates (number), totalTemplates (number). Calculate the fill percentage as (usedTemplates / totalTemplates * 100), handling division by zero by returning 0%. Render an SVG circle element using stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset to visualize the Used (filled arc) vs Available (unfilled arc) proportion. Use a blue gradient or solid color for the filled arc. Do not use Recharts or any external chart library.

Add a new query hook useListMetrics that fetches the backend's getListMetrics capability and returns an array of ListMetrics records. Each record contains listId, listName, totalTemplates, usedTemplates, availableTemplates, and percentUsed. Enable refetch on mount and ensure the query can be manually refetched by the admin panel.

Add a new 'Metrics' sub-section within the AdminComments view. Use the useListMetrics query hook to fetch dynamic metrics for all comment lists. For each list, render a metrics card displaying: list name, Total / Used / Available counts (all from the backend query), a horizontal progress bar with fill percentage (Used/Total * 100), and a MetricsDonutChart component visualizing the used vs available proportion. Ensure all numbers are dynamic with zero hardcoded values. The progress bar should show 0% fill when no templates are used and 100% fill when all are used.
